name: Generalized Voxelization with Non-Cubic Elements
aliases: Voxelization using elements of different shapes
definition: A voxelization algorithm that approximates a 3D polygonal object O using a set of elements P from a palette, where each element Ev is bounded by and contained within a single voxel V of a regular grid. The goal is to minimize approximation error without increasing memory occupation compared to standard cubic voxels.
